opening.argument: The speaker describes using a gift card for a personal trip to Ulta, identifies foundation and a few other items she needs, and later selects a foundation shade. The footage shows cosmetics on display and an employee testing makeup on her face. Those details support an ordinary shopping visit involving product selection and shade matching, not an offer to viewers. The speaker also asks viewers to subscribe, but that request is not tied to a payment, investment, credential request, or other deceptive offer. Nothing in the cited shopping interaction establishes that viewers are being asked to buy into or claim anything.
